dj.hotcue_clear_title: Hot Cue delete mode (or Shift+click to delete)
dj.cue_pro_title: CUE (Press to return to CUE, hold in pause for CUP)
dj.phase_align_tooltip: ALIGN: progressive micro-adjustment of beat phase based on the estimated (provisional) beat grid. Both decks must be playing.
dj.phase_align_completed_tooltip: Micro-slew maneuver completed (acoustic alignment not certified)
dj.phase_align_rejected_state: Alignment cannot run in the current deck state
dj.phase_align_grid_tooltip: Provisional beatgrid based on the first detected transient; it does not guarantee correct identification of the bar's first beat.
dj.sync_reject_slave_track: SYNC rejected: this deck has no track loaded.
dj.sync_reject_slave_bpm: SYNC rejected: this deck's track has no valid analyzed BPM.
dj.sync_reject_master_track: SYNC rejected: the opposite deck has no track loaded to act as Master.
dj.sync_reject_master_bpm: SYNC rejected: the Master deck's track has no valid analyzed BPM.
dj.sync_reject_insufficient_evidence: SYNC rejected: both decks need BPM, sufficient confidence, unambiguous analysis, and alternate candidates.
dj.sync_reject_half_time: SYNC rejected: the Slave's alternate BPM matches the Master's primary BPM ({{masterBpm}} vs {{slaveBpm}} BPM). Confirm the beat level before using SYNC.
dj.sync_reject_double_time: SYNC rejected: the Master's alternate BPM matches the Slave's primary BPM ({{masterBpm}} vs {{slaveBpm}} BPM). Confirm the beat level before using SYNC.
dj.sync_reject_pitch_limit: SYNC rejected: the target tempo ({{targetBpm}} BPM) exceeds this track's pitch range (±8%) ({{trackBpm}} BPM).
dj.sync_master_tooltip: This deck is the Master: it sets the reference tempo the slave deck follows.
dj.bar_sync_tooltip: BAR SYNC: places this deck's bar start in the same phase as the Master, calculated from the confirmed downbeats.
dj.bar_sync_armed_tooltip: Bar prepared. When you press PLAY, the slave starts in phase with the master, recalculated at the moment it starts (click to cancel).
dj.bar_sync_already_aligned_tooltip: Playhead already at the master's bar phase within tolerance (click to clear)
dj.bar_sync_completed_tooltip: Slave launched in phase with the master from the confirmed downbeats.
dj.bar_sync_reason_rejected_state: BAR SYNC cannot prepare in the current state: the Master must be playing and the Slave must be stopped or paused.
dj.bar_sync_reason_rejected_unconfirmed: BAR SYNC requires a manually confirmed downbeat and meter (beats and note value) on both tracks. Confirm them in the downbeat editor.
dj.bar_sync_reason_rejected_no_downbeat: No confirmed downbeat is available for both tracks.
dj.bar_sync_reason_rejected_metric_mismatch: The confirmed beats per bar and note unit must match on both tracks.
dj.bar_sync_reason_rejected_limits: Check that both tracks have valid positions, duration, and BPM.
dj.bar_sync_reason_rejected_confidence: BAR SYNC requires reliable, non-ambiguous BPM evidence with no unresolved half-time or double-time hypothesis.
dj.bar_sync_reason_generic: BAR SYNC could not prepare under the current conditions.
dj.bar_sync_armed_badge_tooltip: Prepared at matching bar phase: {{prepared}}s (Previous: {{prev}}s, Δ {{disp}}s, confirmed downbeat anchor: {{target}}s, {{beats}} beats/bar). PLAY starts in phase with the master.
dj.bar_sync_already_aligned_badge_tooltip: Already at matching bar phase: {{prepared}}s (Previous: {{prev}}s, Δ {{disp}}s, {{beats}} beats/bar). PLAY starts in phase with the master.
dj.bar_sync_armed_btn_tooltip: BAR SYNC ARMED: bar prepared at {{prepared}}s (Previous: {{prev}}s, Δ {{disp}}s, {{beats}} beats/bar). PLAY starts in phase with the master (click to cancel).
dj.bar_sync_aligned_btn_tooltip: BAR SYNC ALIGNED: playhead already at the master's bar phase ({{prepared}}s, Previous: {{prev}}s, Δ {{disp}}s, {{beats}} beats/bar). PLAY starts in phase with the master (click to clear).
dj.downbeat_btn_use_suggested_tooltip: Use analysis suggested position as starting point
dj.downbeat_btn_confirm_tooltip: Manually confirm downbeat and bar metric
dj.downbeat_btn_confirm_disabled_hash: Cannot confirm: track lacks a valid SHA-256 hash
dj.downbeat_missing_hash_explanation: Confirmation unavailable: track lacks a valid SHA-256 cryptographic hash.
dj.downbeat_error_persist: Failed to persist downbeat in local storage.
dj.downbeat_error_invalid_pos: Position must be a valid number between 0 and track duration.
dj.role_master_tooltip: Master deck: sets the reference tempo. The other deck follows it when SYNC is on.
dj.role_slave_tooltip: Slave deck: its BPM is matched to Deck {{master}} ({{bpm}} BPM) with a pitch of {{pitch}}, within the ±8% limit. Beat phase is not changed.
dj.sync_tooltip: SYNC: matches this deck's BPM to the Master deck by adjusting pitch (±8% max). It does not change beat phase.
dj.sync_active_tooltip_detail: SYNC on: BPM matched to Deck {{master}} ({{bpm}} BPM), pitch {{pitch}} (±8% limit). Phase is unchanged; use ALIGN or BAR SYNC to align it. Click to turn off.
dj.meter_pending_tooltip: Confirm the downbeat and meter (e.g. 4/4) in the downbeat editor to use BAR SYNC with this track.
dj.meter_unit_pending_tooltip: The downbeat is confirmed, but the meter's note value is missing. Choose the meter (e.g. 4/4) and press Confirm again to enable BAR SYNC.
dj.downbeat_metric_tooltip: Track meter: beats per bar / note value. BAR SYNC requires the same meter on both decks.
dj.bar_sync_block_is_master: This deck is the Master. BAR SYNC is prepared on the slave deck.
dj.bar_sync_block_no_track: Load a track on this deck.
dj.bar_sync_block_master_no_track: Load a track on Deck {{master}} to use it as the reference.
dj.bar_sync_block_self_unconfirmed: Confirm this track's downbeat and meter in the downbeat editor.
dj.bar_sync_block_master_unconfirmed: Confirm the downbeat and meter of the track on Deck {{master}}.
dj.bar_sync_block_meter_mismatch: The meters do not match ({{self}} vs {{master_meter}} on Deck {{master}}).
dj.bar_sync_block_master_not_playing: Play Deck {{master}}: BAR SYNC needs the Master playing.
dj.bar_sync_block_self_playing: Pause this deck: BAR SYNC prepares a stopped or paused slave deck.
dj.bar_sync_block_tempo_mismatch: The tempos do not match ({{self_bpm}} vs {{master_bpm}} BPM). Turn on SYNC first: with different tempos the phase is lost within a few bars and the kick doubles.
dj.bar_sync_reason_rejected_tempo_mismatch: BAR SYNC requires the same effective BPM on both decks. Turn on SYNC before preparing the bar.
